What we do

Engine work, clearly defined.

Specialist machining and rebuilding work for engine components, assemblies and repair requirements.

01

Engine Machining

Precision machining of engine components and surfaces where worn, damaged or out-of-spec dimensions need to be restored.

02

Engine Boring

Cylinder bore work to restore the required bore condition and dimensions as part of an engine rebuild or reconditioning job.

03

Head & Block Work

Cylinder head and block machining, surface preparation and related work required during engine repair and rebuilding.

04

Crankshaft Work

Machining and related crankshaft work carried out as required by the condition and specifications of the engine.

05

Piston Work

Piston and connecting-rod related work supporting correct fitment and the rebuilding of the engine assembly.

06

Rebuilding & Overhauling

Component-level engine rebuilding and overhaul work, from dismantled parts through machining, preparation and reassembly.

About Piston Pulse

Engine work built on practical experience.

Piston Pulse was established in 2019, building on practical engineering experience developed through SkillTech Engineering in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Piston Pulse presence in Malappuram was introduced in 2025.

The focus is specialist engine machining, rebuilding, reconditioning and component work, with the aim of providing a dependable machining facility for automotive workshops, businesses and vehicle owners.

Looking ahead

Piston Pulse is being developed as a broader automotive engineering brand, with scope to expand into related mechanical and automotive engineering capabilities over time.
